Questions 26–30

Answer the questions below.

Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

26 How did the students do their practical sessions?

27 In the second semester how often did Kira work in a hospital?

transcript.en: Hello, Kira, how are you?
transcript.zh: 你好，基拉，最近好吗？

transcript.en: Fine thanks, Paul, how are you?
transcript.zh: 很好，谢谢，保罗，你最近好吗？

transcript.en: Well, thanks.
transcript.zh: 很好

transcript.en: It's good to see you.
transcript.zh: 谢谢，见到你很高兴，

transcript.en: It must be twelve months since you did our course?
transcript.zh: 自从你上完我们的课程到现在已经有一年了

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 没错

transcript.en: It's nice to come back and say hello.
transcript.zh: 回来再见面的感觉很好

transcript.en: What course did you enroll in?
transcript.zh: 你参加的是什么课程？

transcript.en: Actually, I went straight into third year Pharmacy.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我直接上的是三年级药剂学。

transcript.en: They credited me with two years, which probably made it more difficult for me.
transcript.zh: 他们给了我两年的学分，这可能让我觉得更难了。

transcript.en: On the other hand, you were lucky to be granted credits.
transcript.zh: 另一方面，你能被授予学分很走运。

transcript.en: Is that why you choose the course?
transcript.zh: 这是你选择这门课的原因吗？

transcript.en: Yes. And, as I'd already finished a course in it in my country, I thought it would be easier if I studied something I already knew.
transcript.zh: 是的，另外我已经在我的国家完成了一门课程。我想如果我学一些我已知的知识会简单一些。

transcript.en: I didn't realise you went into third year.
transcript.zh: 我不知道你上的是三年级

transcript.en: I thought you started in first year.
transcript.zh: 我以为你要从一年级开始学

transcript.en: No wonder it was so hard!
transcript.zh: 怪不得会很难

transcript.en: And what do you think is one of the big differences between studying at a university here and studying in your country?
transcript.zh: 你觉得在这里上大学和在你的国家上大学最大的区别之一是什么

transcript.en: Well, I found it very difficult to write assignments, because I wasn't familiar with that aspect of the system here.
transcript.zh: 我发现写作业很难，因为我不熟悉这边在这方面的体系是什么。

transcript.en: The main problem is that the lecturers expect you to be critical.
transcript.zh: 主要的问题是老师希望你具有批判性

transcript.en: That made me feel really terrible.
transcript.zh: 这让我觉得很糟糕

transcript.en: I thought "How can I possibly do it?
transcript.zh: 我想:“我怎么可能做这个

transcript.en: How can I comment on someone else's research when they probably spent five years doing it?"
transcript.zh: 当他们可能花了5年做一个研究的时候，我怎么能对它提意见呢？”

transcript.en: I think a lot of people who come from overseas countries have similar problems.
transcript.zh: 我想许多留学生都和我有一样的问题

transcript.en: But after a while it became easier for me.
transcript.zh: 但是过了一阵时间，这对我来说就很简单了。

transcript.en: People expect you to have problems with the process of reading and writing but, in fact, it is more a question of altering your viewpoint towards academic study.
transcript.zh: 人们认为你会在读写上有问题，但事实上，问题来自改变你对学术研究的观点。

transcript.en: How was the content of the lectures?
transcript.zh: 讲课的内容是什么

transcript.en: Was it easy for you?
transcript.zh: 对你来说简单吗？

transcript.en: I didn't really have many problems understanding lectures.
transcript.zh: 我在理解课程上没有什么问题

transcript.en: The content was very similar to what I'd studied before.
transcript.zh: 学习的内容和我之间学的很像

transcript.en: And what about the lecturers themselves?
transcript.zh: 老师怎么样

transcript.en: Are they essentially the same as lecturers in your country?
transcript.zh: 他们在本质上和你的国家的老师一样吗？

transcript.en: Well actually, no.
transcript.zh: 事实上不是这样

transcript.en: Here, they are much easier to approach.
transcript.zh: 这里的老师很容易接近

transcript.en: After every lecture you can go and ask them something you didn't understand.
transcript.zh: 每节课后，你都能找他们问你不懂的问题

transcript.en: Or you can make an appointment and talk to them about anything in the course.
transcript.zh: 或者你可以预约与他们讨论课上的任何事

transcript.en: Maybe you found them different because you're more mature student now, whereas when you were studying in your country you were younger and not so assertive.
transcript.zh: 也许你发觉他们不同是因为你现在更成熟了，当你在你的国家上学时，你还很年轻，观点不是很明确。

transcript.en: No, I don't think that's the difference.
transcript.zh: 不，我不认为这是区别。

transcript.en: Most of the students here do it.
transcript.zh: 这里的很多学生都这么做

transcript.en: In my faculty, they all seem to make appointments - usually to talk about something in the course that's worrying them, but sometimes just about something that might really interest them, something they might want to specialise in.
transcript.zh: 在我的系里，他们似乎都会预约，通常谈论课上让他们烦恼的问题，但是有时谈论的只是他们感兴趣的话题，一些让他们想要专门从事的事情。

transcript.en: The lecturers must set aside certain times every week when they're available for students.
transcript.zh: 老师必须每周留出一定的时间给学生

transcript.en: That's good to hear.
transcript.zh: 这很好

transcript.en: And how was your timetable?
transcript.zh: 你的课程安排怎么样

transcript.en: Was it a very busy year?
transcript.zh: 是很忙碌的一年吗？

transcript.en: Very, very busy.
transcript.zh: 非常忙碌

transcript.en: They make you work very hard.
transcript.zh: 他们要让你非常努力的学习

transcript.en: Apart from lectures, we had practical sessions in a lot of subjects.
transcript.zh: 除了讲座，我们的很多科目都有实习课。

transcript.en: We did these in small groups.
transcript.zh: 我们在小组里完成这些

transcript.en: I had to go and work four hours every week in a community pharmacy.
transcript.zh: 我不得不每周在社区药房工作4小时

transcript.en: Actually, I enjoyed this very much - meeting new people all the time.
transcript.zh: 事实上我很享受这一切，总是能遇见新的人。

transcript.en: Then in second semester, we had to get experience in hospital dispensaries, so every second day we went to one of the big hospitals and worked there.
transcript.zh: 之后在第二学期，我们就去了医院的药房实习，所以每两天我们就去其中一家大医院并在那里工作。

transcript.en: And on top of all that we had our assignments, which took me a lot of time.
transcript.zh: 而且最重要的是我们还有作业，这花了我很多时间。

transcript.en: Oh, I nearly forgot, between first and second semesters, we had to work full-time for two weeks in a hospital.
transcript.zh: 我差点忘了，在第一和第二学期之间，我们不得不在医院全职工作两周。

transcript.en: That does sound a very heavy year.
transcript.zh: 听起来是任务很重的一年

transcript.en: So are you pleased now that you did it?
transcript.zh: 那么你喜欢你的工作吗？

transcript.en: Do you feel some sense of achievement?
transcript.zh: 你感到有成就感吗？

transcript.en: Yeah, I do feel much more confident, which I suppose is the most important thing.
transcript.zh: 是的，我确实感到更有自信了，我想这也是最重要的。

transcript.en: And have you got any recommendations for people who are studying from overseas?
transcript.zh: 你对海外求学的学生有什么建议吗？

transcript.en: Well, I suppose they need very good English.
transcript.zh: 我想他们需要英语很好。

transcript.en: It would be much better if they spent more time learning English before they enter the university, because you can be in big trouble if you don't understand what people are saying and you haven't got time to translate.
transcript.zh: 最好是他们能在入学前多花时间学好英语，。因为如果你听不懂人们说话又没时间翻译的话，你会陷入大麻烦

transcript.en: Anything else?
transcript.zh: 还有吗？

transcript.en: Well, as I said before, the biggest problem for me was a lack of familiarity with the education system here.
transcript.zh: 正如我之前说的，对于我来说，最大的问题是缺乏对这里教育体系的认知，

transcript.en: It sounds as if it was a real challenge.
transcript.zh: 这听起来像是一个真正的挑战。

transcript.en: Congratulations, Kira.
transcript.zh: 祝贺你，基拉。

transcript.en: Thanks,Paul.
transcript.zh: 谢谢，保罗。
